digest.component_or_area: reconciler backend port / vendor adapter seam
propositions: Four core modules (fetcher, applier, apply_handlers, _attestation) directly import and call adapters.jira.acli_subprocess for scalar concerns (project resolution, environment attestation, assignee errors), violating the vendor-neutral port contract.

The Backend Protocol must expose read-only scalar accessors (project, query_project, assert_env_ready) and neutral exceptions (BackendEnvError, BackendAssigneeNotFoundError) so core modules resolve these concerns through the backend facade rather than direct vendor imports.

Nested function-level lazy imports of adapters.jira in the four modules must be removed and replaced with backend method calls, verified by a full-tree AST walker that detects imports at any nesting depth.

JiraBackend must implement the new scalar members by delegating to resolve_jira_settings with correct defaulting semantics (DIG default for applier guard, un-defaulted for fetcher fail-closed behavior).
The S2 contract suite and FakeBackend test double must be updated to satisfy the widened Backend Protocol via structural typing.
ADR 0035 section (d) interface table must document the new scalar members and neutral exceptions as canonical reference for future backend implementors.
